channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Nevada has avoided a large-scale ICE deployment so far. Why?
item.description: The state hasn’t resisted Trump’s immigration agenda as overtly as some peers, though observers say it’s naive to think that a crackdown couldn’t happen here.

item.title: Nevada ha evitado hasta ahora un despliegue masivo de ICE. ¿Por qué?
item.description: El estado no se ha resistido a la agenda migratoria Trump tan abiertamente como otras entidades, aunque observadores dicen que es ingenuo pensar que no se podrían tomar medidas enérgicas aquí.

item.title: Death Valley landmark Scotty’s Castle is reopening for limited tours after years of flood repairs
item.description: Scotty's Castle, built in the 1920s, is tucked away in the desert in Death Valley National Park and was one of the park's biggest attractions.

item.title: Industrias del juego y del turismo en franja hotelera de Las Vegas batallaron en 2025
item.description: La afluencia de visitantes retrocede a niveles del 2021, casinos apenas logran signos positivos, y el aeropuerto sufre una fuerte caída en cifras de pasajeros. Mientras tanto, los mercados locales prosperan.

item.title: Henderson makes millions by detaining ICE suspects, but it might not cover costs
item.description: Since 2020, revenue from the city’s contract with ICE has nearly halved, according to data from a public records request. In 2025, the facility made $3.5 million in revenue from its agreement with ICE — a significant decrease from the $7.3 million the contract generated in 2020.

item.title: Nevada school budget heyday was short-lived. Why several districts are now in dire straits
item.description: Three years after Nevada school leaders celebrated a historical, 26 percent K-12 education funding increase, a number of their districts now face dire financial outlooks.

item.title: OPINION: Holding out hope for Nevada’s most woebegone lake
item.description: A healthy Walker Lake would rejuvenate more than water and wildlife; it would recharge a windswept county in a place that fast-growing Nevada has largely forgotten.

item.title: Some Nevada workers may see health premium hikes; officials say they took too long to act
item.description: The Public Employees’ Benefit Program is suffering from a “perfect storm” of problems, according to state officials, who haven't made decisions on how to ensure the program emerges from a deep deficit but expect to set new premium rates soon.

item.title: Cómo trabajan los gobiernos locales del sur de Nevada con ICE
item.description: ¿Qué acuerdos tienen las ciudades y condados con ICE? ¿Qué han dicho sus funcionarios electos acerca de esa agencia federal?

item.title: Nevada fake elector case resumes with debate over intent behind 2020 pro-Trump ceremony
item.description: During Monday’s hearing, Clark County Judge Mary Kay Holthus was skeptical of the prosecution’s arguments for the "offering a false instrument" charge because it requires an “intent to defraud.”
